import numpy as np
import albumentations as A

def geometric_augmentation_pipeline():
    pipeline = A.Compose([
        A.ShiftScaleRotate(
            shift_limit=0.0625,
            scale_limit=0.1,
            rotate_limit=45,
            p=0.5
        ),
        A.ElasticTransform(
            alpha=1.0,
            sigma=50.0,
            alpha_affine=50,
            p=0.3
        ),
        A.GridDistortion(
            num_steps=5,
            distort_limit=0.3,
            p=0.3
        )
    ])
    return pipeline

sample_image = np.random.randint(0, 256, (128, 128, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
pipeline = geometric_augmentation_pipeline()
augmented = pipeline(image=sample_image)['image']

print(f"Original shape: {sample_image.shape}")
print(f"Augmented shape: {augmented.shape}")
assert augmented.shape == sample_image.shape
